claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_mechanics.on_hit_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Frost Brand's core weapon rider is an item-scoped on-hit trigger. The current magic-item surface only allows passive, activation, or composites of those two, while on-hit riders exist only for masteries.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit with an attack roll using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 1d6 Cold damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: extinguish_nonmagical_flames
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The draw-triggered property has a deterministic environmental effect that is not representable by any current effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you draw this weapon, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 feet of yourself.
